insight: Author created an HTML app to teach kids about investing
App is a single HTML file that works as a PWA (Progressive Web App)
Son asked for money instead of birthday gifts to start investing
App shows investment growing daily on old smartphone attached to fridge
Purpose is teaching kids compound interest and how investment grows over time
Author acts as investment agent assigning realistic interest rates
App is called D-iNvestments (mix of Diversions and Investments)
Setup uses affordable materials: old smartphone and suction mount ($0.90)
App displays daily, weekly, and monthly gains plus total balance
Schools don't teach personal finance management
